Release notes

What's new on Mac.

Moonlit for Mac updates itself. Here is what the last three releases changed.

Version 1.0.5 19 Aug 2026
  • Automatic subtitle sync. Moonlit checks external subtitles against the audio and corrects the timing on its own.
  • Redesigned subtitle panel with grouped Presets, Text, Position, and Outline & Shadow controls.
  • Subtitles lift out of the way when playback controls are visible, for embedded and external tracks alike.
Version 1.0.4 18 Aug 2026
  • Episodes resume where you left off. Detail pages scroll straight to the episode you would watch next.
  • Genre and language tiles show their artwork more reliably.
  • Removed watch progress now stays removed across devices.
  • The update dialog no longer interrupts other apps.
Version 1.0.3 18 Aug 2026
  • Sign in with Apple.
  • Hover glow now matches across the app. Genre, folder and award hub tiles glow like posters do.
  • Fixed occasional sign-outs on launch caused by a brief network hiccup.

Questions

Before you subscribe.

Anything else, ask us on the Support page.

Can I change plans later?

Yes. Upgrade or downgrade from Billing at any time. The change applies on your next billing date.

What happens when I cancel?

Your profiles and library stay until the end of the paid period. Nothing is deleted on the day you cancel.

What does an invite code do?

A Moonlit admin can invite friends and family onto their household catalog at no cost. You get a normal profile and library without a subscription.

Do I need my own sources?

No. The catalog and stream ranking are managed for you on every plan. Studio lets power users add their own sources on top.
